wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Start here: answer one sideways question for a suggested first world, or skip and jump straight into any world card.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: Try every question style, see what each one reads, and launch directly into the matching world from one place.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan the full site in one pass, with one plain line on what each page is and what to do first.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Follow one breathing ring, lower the dimmer, and set one burden down before moving on.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Open your persona sky at full scale: ask for a reading, catch meteors, play chimes, orbit it, and mint a postcard.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Turn your persona sky into logbook entries, replay how stars arrived, and seal capsules to reload later.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Pulse your persona sky into drifting echoes, pick one to hear its thought, then print an echo weather bulletin.

worlds.name: the pulse choir
worlds.what: Turn your persona sky into a looping choir, conduct by tempo and muting, then print a constellation score.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Kindle stars from your persona sky as lanterns, let them drift, and pull a ritual reading from the glow.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Grow each star from your persona sky into a swaying plant, tap stems for thoughts, and ask for a greenhouse forecast.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Map your persona sky as pressure systems, launch probes into microclimates, and print a forecast from the live field.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Mirror your persona sky into a rotating mandala, tune symmetry, ripple it by touch, and print a geometry mantra.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Run any elementary cellular automaton rule, flip bits live, and watch tiny changes rewrite the whole machine.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Throw heavy blocks by pointer or keyboard, flip gravity, and turn raw momentum into a playable physics mess.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Plant into soil cross-sections, water and turn the ground, and watch roots route around grit and stone.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Feed a word into the fire and pull out a coined term with its own invented definition and citation.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: Deal impossible specimens one by one, pin favorites to your drawer, and cross-reference strange matches.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Spin your persona sky through changing rune sets, archive omens, and forge a downloadable sigil.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: If a link misses, you still land in a playable station with a radio, decoder, scope, and clear routes back in.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: Get the same page list in XML, with relative paths so the site works under any publish path.
